findings.message: The Vorbis comment vendor string names "Lavf60.16.100", but the Segment WritingApp element names "encspect fixtures"; other software may have rewritten the file, and kept one of them.
Track 1 (A_VORBIS) is encrypted (AES-CTR), so its frames cannot be analyzed.
